column1: An IfcPlate is a planar and often flat part with constant thickness. A plate may carry loads between or beyond points of support, or provide stiffening. The location of the plate (being horizontal, vertical or sloped) is not relevant to its definition (in contrary to IfcWall and IfcSlab (as floor slab)).
column9: CURTAIN_PANEL, SHEET, FLANGE_PLATE, WEB_PLATE, STIFFENER_PLATE, GUSSET_PLATE, COVER_PLATE, SPLICE_PLATE, BASE_PLATE

column4: Holds the entity specific enumerations from the IFC standard that classifies the entity. If a custom value is needed, the attribute ObjectTypeOverride has to be used to define such custom type, whereas the PredefinedType is set to USERDEFINED.
This value is required if available
Allows for a custom value to be added, if no applicable PredefinedType enumerator can be found.
